The structure of Mn3Cu4Ge8 (Mn3(CuGe2)4) adopts the tetragonal space group I4_1/amd (No. 119), with 15 atoms per unit cell across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu and Mn centers each coordinated by 10 neighbors, while Ge centers have 12 neighbors with a close-packed-like local arrangement. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and face-sharing between Cu and Mn 10-vertex polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among Ge 12-vertex polyhedra. The neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 15 sites.
